best.description: Adds that Freudenthal called Finns an inferior 'Turanian' people, a medal section tying the SFP's Freudenthal medal to compulsory Swedish, and (in later versions) that the SFP never disowned his 'racist doctrines'.

best.label: contested
best.description: Puts back a sentence, cited to a 2002 Helsingin Sanomat editorial critical of the league, that the association has a few hundred active members.

best.label: campaign
best.description: Adds paragraphs, cited to one magazine article, saying the Sámi are not more indigenous than the Finns, that prehistoric people cannot be divided into Sámi and Finns, that Sámi identity is under 100 years old and that 'Sápmi' was invented in the 1980s.

best.label: contested
best.description: Rewrites the IKL lead as a 'far-right fascist party that took many influences from German National Socialism and European fascism' and says its black-shirt uniform had a swastika armband 'like the Nazis'.

best.label: campaign
best.description: Adds a section 'Fennomania in the internet era': the term now means opponents of compulsory Swedish, some of whom 'oppose anything with even a hint of Swedishness'.

worst.label: campaign
worst.description: Turns the redirect 'Metsäsaamelaiset' into an article stating that the Forest Sámi are one of the (four) Sámi groups living in Finland and were refused the Sámi Parliament electoral roll because they lost their language.

worst.label: contested
worst.description: Recasts de Wit's 'Laiton lehti?' publication as a 'vulgar nationalist blog' and adds that he became known for transporting corpses on a van floor (Yle MOT story, cited) and that his partner sits on the SKE board as treasurer.

worst.label: contested
worst.description: Adds a 'Criticism' section saying Turtiainen's pro-Russia line would likely drop Finnish living standards to Russian levels (average wage 621 euros a month), cited to an article on Russian army pay.

worst.label: contested
worst.description: Adds a paragraph saying the Lapua movement's first meetings were in Swedish-speaking parishes, that its Swedish-speaking support 'has been more or less hushed up', and that Swedish-speaking nobles in it looked down on Finnish.
